messages:
Dmitri: :rotating_light: Canary failing after last rollout (rollout-id=rollout-2026-03-09-v2). Healthchecks for canary nodes are flipping to FAIL and we're seeing elevated 5xx/502s for ~3% of production requests. Automated abort didn't kick — looks like threshold config wasn't applied to this host pool.
Incident Bot: ALERT: canary_healthcheck_failures > 5% over 2m for service=redwood-infer-runtime-canary (see https://ops.internal/alerts/rollout-1767209456). metrics: http_5xx_rate=4.8%, ready=false on 2/6 canaries, spike started at 1767209400.
Lina: @Dmitri fyi — is this customer impacting? should we page the oncall? :eyes:
Sam: I'm on it. Initial glance: readiness probe on the new image responds 503 intermittently. Appears to be a missing env var in the new config that causes the init path to error. grabbing pod logs now.
Sam: logs snippet:
```
2026-03-09T15:50:11Z ERROR bootstrap failed: missing required env REDWOOD_MODEL_PATH
2026-03-09T15:50:11Z WARN healthcheck: readiness=false
2026-03-09T15:50:12Z INFO retrying init
```
Oncall SRE: Taking over the page. @Sam please confirm whether we can flip the rollout feature flag or if rollback is safer. Also pinging infra for fast rollback permission.
Dmitri: We have a feature flag for this rollout: `rollout_v2_gate`. I just tried toggling it but the flag service returned 500 (likely overloaded). Command we normally use: `redwood-ff toggle --flag rollout_v2_gate --env prod --off` — attempting now.
Dmitri: `> redwood-ff toggle --flag rollout_v2_gate --env prod --off`
Dmitri: Response: ERROR 500 from flags API. So flag path is not reliable right now.
Oncall SRE: OK fallback: initiating cluster-level rollback on the canary deployment. Executing `kubectl -n prod rollout undo deployment/runtime-canary --to-revision=2` now.
Sam: note: if we rollback, the new image wrote a small state file to an ephemeral dir, but should not affect primary service. Rollback safe for now.
Oncall SRE: rollback started. watching pods.
Maria (Support): fyi got a ticket from AcmeCorp complaining about repeated 502s starting ~15:50 UTC. Ticket includes trace id `trace-0a1b2c`. They reported intermittent timeouts on embeddings endpoint.
Oncall SRE: rollback complete on canary group. New pods are Ready. healthcheck metrics: http_5xx_rate down to 0.7% in last 60s.
Incident Bot: RESOLVED: canary_healthcheck_failures cleared (metric below threshold). Alert auto-closed at 1767209720.
Lina: good work. Quick summary for postmortem: cause=missing env var in rollout image + flag service 500 prevented quick kill-switch; detection=automated canary check; mitigation=cluster rollback; customer impact=brief 502 spike affecting ~2-3% traffic, one enterprise ticket. Owner for postmortem?
Dmitri: I'll own the postmortem. Action items: (1) add e2e guard to rollout pipeline to validate envs, (2) fix flags API resilience, (3) update canary abort policy to fallback to rollout rollback if flag toggles fail.
Oncall SRE: handing off to Dmitri for postmortem and next steps. I've updated the incident channel with timelines and links. /handoff :thumbsup:
Dmitri: Thanks — I will draft postmortem and tag infra and flags team. Closing thread. :shipit:
